title: Updates
help: Update dPanel to a newer release, or roll an update back.
updateHelp: The panel backs up its .env, database and code first. If the new version fails to install or its checks fail, the backup is restored on its own. The panel may not answer for a few minutes while it restarts.
confirmUpdate: Update dPanel to {ref} now? The panel restarts during the update.
alreadyRunning: An update is running. Open its log in the history below.
noCommitList: GitHub could not list the changes for this version.
reconnecting: Waiting for the panel to answer again; it restarts during the update.
noHistory: No update has run from the panel yet.
rollbackHelp: The code and .env from before this update are put back, then the update steps run again on them. A backup of the current state is taken first.
restoreDatabaseHelp: Taken at {time}. Everything changed in the panel since then is lost: websites, mailboxes, DNS records and users.
keepDatabaseWarning: The database stays as it is. If the newer version changed its tables, the older code may not work with them.
